title: Address PR #142 review: strengthen PDF text extraction in audit bundle
description: Review feedback on PR #142 (loreweaver-agv): the extractPdfPages function groups items by y-coordinate but joins in pdfjs return order, which is not guaranteed left-to-right. Three improvements requested: (1) sort each y-group by x before joining, (2) emit coordinate-preserving JSON items artifact per page, (3) update README to note plain text is a review aid. Scope: packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts only. No parser/pack/canonical data changes.
close_reason: All three review items implemented and verified in f9d9938; pushed to PR #142.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Review item 1 (x-sort): ACCEPTED. Current code groups by y but joins in pdfjs stream order, which is not left-to-right on multi-column/stat-block pages. The importer's extract.ts confirms this at line 390: row.sort((a, b) => a.transform[4] - b.transform[4]). Same fix applies here — sort each y-group by transform[4] before joining. Technically correct and within scope.

Review item 2 (coordinate JSON): ACCEPTED. pdfjs provides transform[4]=x, transform[5]=y, height, and width on every text item. Emitting per-page JSON at pdf-text/page-NNN.items.json co-locates items with existing text files and lets reviewers cross-reference exact positions. No behavior change to existing outputs. Technically correct and within scope.

Review item 3 (README disclaimer): ACCEPTED. Plain text is a secondary review artifact; the coordinate JSON plus the original PDF are the authoritative sources for position-sensitive review. Documentation is accurate.
